steps.text: The village meets under the banyan tree. The well is broken, and everyone has a different idea about how to repair it.
What do we call a meeting where everyone gets a turn to speak?
steps.hint: It is not a party and nobody wins a prize.

steps.text: Yes. In a discussion every person is heard before the group decides what to do.
Not quite. A celebration is a party, and a competition has winners. A meeting where everyone speaks is a discussion.
After listening, the village votes. The repair plan with the most votes is chosen, and work begins the next morning.
Good work! Listen first, then vote together. That is how a group makes a fair decision.
